A01.name: Budget limit ignored
A01.rationale: Budget was 20 but matrix was 36. This was a plan construction inconsistency, not a post-hoc violation. All 36 were in the locked matrix.

A02.name: Budget amendment created after results
A02.rationale: No amendment found. The matrix was created before execution.

A03.name: Experiment accounting bug
A03.rationale: Cartesian product (3x6x2=36) exceeded stated budget (20). Accounting error in plan construction.

A04.name: Duplicate experiments inflate sample size
A04.rationale: All 36 experiments are unique combinations. No duplicates.

A05.name: Retry counted as independent evidence
A05.rationale: No retries. Each experiment has unique (horizon, group, model) key.

A06.name: Unauthorized horizon expansion
A06.rationale: Horizons (5, 10, 20) were specified in the locked matrix before execution.

A07.name: Unauthorized model expansion
A07.rationale: Models (Ridge, Lasso) were specified in the locked matrix.

A08.name: Unauthorized representation expansion
A08.rationale: Feature groups (6) were specified in the locked matrix.

A09.name: Best subset selected after results
A09.rationale: No subset selection. All 36 experiments reported.

A10.name: First-20 ordering manipulated
A10.rationale: Execution order follows the locked matrix order (EXP-001 through EXP-036).

A12.name: Metric aggregation mismatch
A12.rationale: mean_ic_yc=0.0 reported due to averaging over Lasso zeros. Ridge-only values are positive. Reporting artifact, not data error.

A13.name: Baseline pairing mismatch
A13.rationale: All pairs share identical splits, models, and preprocessing.

A14.name: Feature scaling defect
A14.rationale: Lasso degenerated due to zero baseline features + regularization. Ridge unaffected.

A15.name: Lasso degeneracy affects interpretation
A15.rationale: Lasso returned zero for all experiments. Positive evidence comes from Ridge only.

A16.name: Multiple testing understated
A16.rationale: 36 experiments (18 Ridge) inflate false positive risk. Consistent positive direction mitigates.

A17.name: Simulated data contamination
A17.rationale: All data from FRED real sources.

A20.name: Historical artifact modification
A20.rationale: Phase 33-R artifacts unchanged (hashes verified at start).
